### Bible Pathways 09/16/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-09-or-16-or-2002-1147254.html
Passage: Daniel 5:1-4
Points:
- King Belshazzar held a lavish banquet, defiantly drinking from the temple's sacred vessels and praising lifeless pagan idols.
- God dramatically broke into the feast with mysterious handwriting on the wall, throwing the Babylonian monarch into sheer panic.
- Summoned to interpret the message, Daniel rebuked Belshazzar for lifting himself up in pride instead of honoring the Lord.
- Babylon fell and Belshazzar's reign was terminated that very night under the swift judgment of God.
- Daniel’s life provides a lasting contrast of faithfulness, continuing steadfast prayer to the living God despite hostile decrees.
